card.name: Verbs of staying level after a change
card.fires_on: Verbs like stayed, remained, continue or been that say a measured quantity held steady or kept its trend, in statistics or lab-result sentences.

modes.label: Held steady
modes.description: A verb saying a value stayed unchanged after a change or compared with others.
modes.example: mining's output<< stayed>> around its base year level

modes.label: Lab counts stable
modes.description: Remained stable after a decrease in a lab value during treatment.
modes.example: during the first year of treatment with dimethyl fumarate and then<< remained>> stable

modes.label: Trend continues
modes.description: Verbs or small words showing an ongoing trend in economic or demographic text.
modes.example: The number has<< been>> declining for decades

card.writes: It pushes toward the word flat, as in prices or counts staying flat.
card.plain: It marks spots in trend sentences where the next word may say a number stayed level.
